choices.answer: Oh my! What a scary monster!
Are you trying to scare me?

dialogues.original: Hehe, did I scare you? I've been practicing!

choices.answer: Almost! Your makeup looks so real!

dialogues.original: Yep! My big brother has the same costume!

choices.answer: You two must look great together!

dialogues.original: Yeah! I practiced my roar all week! RAAAWR!
Thanks! My mom said I scared the mailman yesterday!
Thanks! It took my mom TWO HOURS to put it on!
Yeah! We're gonna combine our candy later!

choices.answer: Smart plan! Here's some for your collection!
Teamwork! I love it! Here you go!

dialogues.original: No, he's too old. He's 13 now. He doesn't trick-or-treat anymore.

choices.answer: Well, more candy for you then!

dialogues.original: Hehe, they think it's funny! Can I have my candy now?

choices.answer: Of course! You've earned it, monster!

dialogues.original: Yeah! And I had to sit REALLY still! It was hard!

choices.answer: You're very patient! Here's your reward!
That's tough! You deserve extra candy!
